fact: Neverlight Grove is a vast cavern where bioluminescent mushrooms cover every surface from floor to ceiling, with a lake at its heart.
source_quote: Neverlight Grove opened before them like a dream. It was a vast cavern where bioluminescent mushrooms covered every surface, floor to ceiling, with a lake at its heart.
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: A mushroom tower is visible beyond a ravine, glimpsed through mist.
source_quote: Beyond a ravine, a mushroom tower is glimpsed through mist.
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: Stool and Rumpadump sprint ahead of the party to greet their sovereigns.
source_quote: Rumpadump cried "We're home! We're home! We're home!" and sprinted ahead with Stool.
subject: Stool and Rumpadump run ahead

fact: Sarith displays a quiet, peaceful expression upon arriving in Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Sarith walked with a quiet, peaceful expression that none of the party had seen on him before.
subject: Sarith

fact: Zalthir wraps himself in a shroud of darkness due to distrust of the environment.
source_quote: Zalthir, ever cautious, wrapped himself in a shroud of darkness, explaining, "I don't trust any of these things."
subject: Zalthir uses Darkness

fact: Phylo is a sovereign of Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: The two sovereigns of the grove, Phylo and Basidia, received them warmly
subject: Phylo

fact: Basidia is a sovereign of Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: The two sovereigns of the grove, Phylo and Basidia, received them warmly
subject: Basidia

fact: Phylo speaks of a coming "day of joy" with eerie enthusiasm.
source_quote: something was immediately, unsettlingly wrong with Phylo. He spoke of a coming "day of joy" with eerie enthusiasm.
subject: Phylo's strange behavior

fact: Phylo praises the Great Seeder, claiming the entity can answer any question.
source_quote: He praised a figure called the "Great Seeder," who could answer any question
subject: Great Seeder

fact: Phylo refers to the Great Seeder using the pronouns "she" and "her."
source_quote: kept calling the entity "she" and "her."
subject: Phylo uses gendered pronouns

fact: Daz notes that referring to the Great Seeder with gendered pronouns is deeply strange because myconids have no gender.
source_quote: Daz recalled that this was deeply strange, because myconids have no gender.
subject: Daz

fact: Basidia is visibly uncomfortable with Phylo's behavior.
source_quote: An insight check revealed that Basidia was staring at Phylo in visible discomfort.
subject: Basidia

fact: Basidia arranges for Phylo to stay behind and leads the tour of the grove herself.
source_quote: She arranged for Phylo to stay behind and led the tour herself.
subject: Basidia leads tour

fact: Phylo agrees to stay behind when Basidia takes charge of the tour.
source_quote: Phylo replies, "Yes, Basidia, you are my sovereign and co-equal in all things."
subject: Phylo

fact: Basidia speaks in hushed, urgent tones while guiding the group through the grove.
source_quote: As she guided the group through the grove, she spoke in hushed, urgent tones.
subject: Basidia

fact: A previous group of "softers" accepted Phylo's hospitality and were taken to the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: A previous group of "softers" had accepted Phylo's hospitality and been taken to the Garden of Welcome.
subject: Previous group of softers

fact: Basidia has not seen the previous group of softers since they were taken to the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: She had not seen them since, and Phylo had never mentioned them again.
subject: Previous group of softers

fact: Rumpadump shouts "We're home! We're home! We're home!" upon entering the grove.
source_quote: Rumpadump shouted: "We're home! We're home! We're home!"
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Gyrgum remarks that Neverlight Grove looks incredible, colorful, and mushroom-y.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Wow, this place looks incredible! So colorful and mushroom-y."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz jokes about the party not having brought pepperoni-mushroom pizzas.
source_quote: Daz jokes that it is a good thing the party has not brought any pepperoni-mushroom pizzas.
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum follows at a distance to watch how the sprouts interact with Phylo and Basidia.
source_quote: Gyrgum follows at a distance to watch how the sprouts interact with Phylo and Basidia.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz climbs onto high ground to observe.
source_quote: Daz climbs onto high ground to observe.
subject: Daz

fact: Eldeth decides Thorin is "crazy" for following the group.
source_quote: Eldeth decides Thorin is "crazy" for following, and she stands next to Daz instead.
subject: Eldeth

fact: Eldeth stands next to Daz on the high ground.
source_quote: Eldeth decides Thorin is "crazy" for following, and she stands next to Daz instead.
subject: Eldeth

fact: Jimjar walks over with the group.
source_quote: Jimjar and Sarith walk over with the group.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Sarith walks over with the group.
source_quote: Jimjar and Sarith walk over with the group.
subject: Sarith

fact: Phylo welcomes Rumpadump and Stool back to the grove.
source_quote: Phylo: "Welcome, welcome back, Rumpadump and Stool."
subject: Phylo

fact: Stool asks where Zalthir is.
source_quote: Stool asks where Zalthir is and adds that "Thorin carried me when I was tired."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool states that Thorin carried him when he was tired.
source_quote: Stool asks where Zalthir is and adds that "Thorin carried me when I was tired."
subject: Stool

fact: Phylo addresses the party as "friendly softers."
source_quote: He addresses them as "friendly softers."
subject: Phylo

fact: Sarith advises the party to stay on the sovereign's good side.
source_quote: Sarith advises staying on the sovereign's good side.
subject: Sarith

fact: Gyrgum plans to praise whatever Phylo shows them.
source_quote: Gyrgum replies, "Oh, I'm planning to praise the heck out of whatever he shows us."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Phylo describes the Great Seeder as living beyond the garden.
source_quote: Phylo describes the Great Seeder, who lives beyond the garden, as all-knowing, wise, and able to answer any question.
subject: Great Seeder

fact: Phylo describes the Great Seeder as all-knowing and wise.
source_quote: Phylo describes the Great Seeder, who lives beyond the garden, as all-knowing, wise, and able to answer any question.
subject: Great Seeder

fact: Phylo describes the Great Seeder as able to answer any question.

subject: Great Seeder

fact: Daz's Arcana/Nature check results in a score of 12, or 23 with help.
source_quote: Daz's Arcana/Nature check comes to 12, and 23 with help.
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum's insight check results in a score of 18.
source_quote: Gyrgum's insight check of 18 catches Basidia looking uncomfortable at Phylo.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The Garden of Welcome is the location where Phylo takes guests after offering hospitality.
source_quote: A previous group of "softers" had accepted Phylo's hospitality and been taken to the Garden of Welcome.
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: Phylo states that the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day.
source_quote: Phylo speaks of a 'day of joy' and a 'great celebration' occurring soon, and offers a tour of the grove but says the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day.
subject: Phylo delays Circle of Masters
